name: Wireframe Polyhedra Pro
description: A new take on Wireframe Stellations: glowing 3D wireframes of the five Platonic solids, stella octangula, small and great stellated dodecahedron, cuboctahedron, icosidodecahedron, a 4D tesseract turning through the fourth dimension and the two original morphing stellations. Free X, Y, Z rotation with auto spin, perspective, inner shell, explode and breathe, line width in pixels, neon glow with hot core, depth fade, running dashes, vertex dots and solid, depth, rainbow or layer colors.
